replacements.Cualquier proceso de cálculo mecánico pu: Any mechanical computation can be described with these three pieces. If an algorithm exists for a computation, a Turing machine can execute it.
replacements.No existe ningún algoritmo que determine: No algorithm can determine, for every possible program and input, whether that program will eventually halt. Some limits of computation are mathematical, not merely practical.
